talking_points: Nvidia's board is investigating whether CEO Jensen Huang's personal relationship with an alleged Chinese agent posed a security risk to the chipmaker.
Google is expanding its own AI chip lineup just as Nvidia faces a distracting scandal, and also quietly bought a stalled $30.9bn data centre project from startup Crusoe.
US margin debt has hit a record $1.5 trillion, a sign investors are borrowing heavily to ride the AI rally.
